The author is speaking as if the **spirit** of each of these kings had actually been asleep and God **awakened** it. If it would be helpful in your language, you could state the meaning plainly. Alternate translation: [So the God of Israel influenced Pul, the king of Assyria, and Tilgath Pilneser, the king of Assyria, to want to conquer them]
See how you decided to spell this name in [5:6](../05/06.md). Alternate translation: [Tiglath Pileser]

The author is not referring to a specific **Reubenite** or **Gadite**. He means the members of those tribes in general. If it would be helpful to your readers, you could use an expression that would be more natural in your language. Alternate translation: [the Reubenites and the Gadites]
See the discussion of the phrase **to this day** in the introduction to 1 Chronicles. Alternate translation: [and they have remained there permanently]
